query: UPDATE catalog.category c SET enabled = false FROM catalog.license_rule l WHERE l.category_id = c.id AND c.enabled AND ( c.code <> ALL($2) OR replace(lower(btrim(c.code)), '_', ' ') = ANY($1) OR replace(lower(btrim(c.name)), '_', ' ') = ANY($1) OR (l.kind IN ('roc', 'roc_and_state_agency') AND cardinality(l.classes) = 0)) RETURNING c.id
